evidence.text: "Obamacare has been a disaster for Illinois. Many counties only have two options for consumers, and our healthcare costs have only gone up over the last decade. We can, and must, do better. Ironically they call it the Affordable Care Act, but it has been unaffordable for most Americans and small businesses.
